title: lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c: Missing CONFIG guard on duty cycle test
description:
test_duty_cycle_ccp13 calls lichen_duty_cycle_* functions without #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_DUTY_CYCLE guard. The sibling test test_duty_cycle_tracker_matches_ccp13_vectors (line 1315) correctly guards these calls. When CONFIG_LICHEN_DUTY_CYCLE is disabled, this test will fail to compile or link.

Fix suggestion: Wrap the test body in #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_DUTY_CYCLE ... #else ztest_test_skip(); #endif like the test at line 1315

Location: line 1310
